sts.armoury.export.tooltip: Copies a shareable STS builder link for the current loadout to your clipboard.
sts.armoury.save.tooltip: Saves the current loadout to your STS profile (if linked) and copies its short link.
sts.armoury.link.tooltip: Links your Minecraft profile to your Discord account so builds save to your profile.
text.autoconfig.sparethesympathy.title: Spare the Sympathy Config
Site URL
Base URL of the STS site (no trailing slash). Defaults to the local dev server.
Export Link on left
Anchor the Export Link button to the left side of the inventory window instead of the right.
Export Link X offset
Horizontal offset from the anchor. Ctrl+dragging the button in-game updates this.
Export Link Y offset
Vertical offset from the anchor. Ctrl+dragging the button in-game updates this.
Save to Profile on left
Anchor the Save to Profile button to the left side of the inventory window instead of the right.
Save to Profile X offset
Horizontal offset from the anchor. Ctrl+dragging the button in-game updates this.
Save to Profile Y offset
Vertical offset from the anchor. Ctrl+dragging the button in-game updates this.
Link Account on left
Anchor the Link Account button to the left side of the inventory window instead of the right.
Link Account X offset
Horizontal offset from the anchor. Ctrl+dragging the button in-game updates this.
Link Account Y offset
Vertical offset from the anchor. Ctrl+dragging the button in-game updates this.
